type.@description: Specifies the type of input to display

autocomplete.@description: Specifies whether the input should have autocomplete enabled

list.@description: Refers to a datalist element that contains pre-defined options for the input

pattern.@description: Specifies a regular expression that the input's value is checked against

placeholder.@description: Specifies a short hint that describes the expected value of the input

required.@description: Specifies that the input must be filled out before submitting the form

readonly.@description: Specifies that the input is read-only

size.@description: Specifies the visible width, in characters, of the input

minlength.@description: Specifies the minimum number of characters allowed in the input

maxlength.@description: Specifies the maximum number of characters allowed in the input

dirname.@description: Specifies that the text direction will be submitted with the form

multiple.@description: Specifies that the user is allowed to enter more than one value (type=email or type=file)

min.@description: Specifies the minimum value (numeric and date-time inputs)

max.@description: Specifies the maximum value (numeric and date-time inputs)

step.@description: Specifies the legal number intervals for the input (numeric and date-time inputs)
